title: Pearce Museum

services.name: School Groups
services.desc: The Pearce Museum invites you and your class to step back in time and experience two events of the 19th century that forged our nation’s identity - the American Civil War and the westward expansion that followed. Enrich your curriculum and complement your classroom studies with our educational programs created to meet TEKS requirements for specific grade levels. While the programs are designed for specific elementary, middle, and high school grades, anyone can be adapted to fit your students’ grade level. blurb: LHOn March 14, 2026, the Pearce Museum hosted a special event to commemorate the closing of the American Civil War. The Civil War collection holds over 17,000 documents and artifacts belonging to those who experienced that tragic time in American history.
